Stop unless every named column is present

Source: R/utils-census.R
dot-RequireColumns.Rd

Stop unless every named column is present

Usage

.RequireColumns(df, chrCols, strName)

Arguments

df

data.frame to check.

chrCols

character Columns that must be present. NULL entries are dropped, so an optional column can be passed straight through.

strName

character Domain name for the message.

Value

NULL, invisibly. Called for the error.
